scope: Milestone B server-side verification of the Android companion client against a live session stack: gateway admission over the real overlay path, SSE stream, typed input into a real Codex TUI, resize re-grid, archived-history paging and jump, capability gates, and wheel delivery. On-device (cover screen) verification is pending the phone joining the overlay network.

harness.recipe: Mirror of scripts/check_restore.py: disposable /tmp runtime, scripts/fake_models.py as the model backend (no quota spend), one real Codex TUI agent in managed mode booted with `lapis_desktop --restore-agents`, plus tools/qa/fake_agent.py installed as a second agent for primary-screen history fixtures. lapis_desktop and lapis_session_service built from this worktree at the revision above (Ghostty prefix reused from the validated pinned build).
harness.gateway: apps/remote/lapis_remote.py from this worktree, run by the existing dev.lapis.remote LaunchAgent with --registry pointed at the disposable workspace; admission exercised through the Mac's ZeroTier address with Host header and peer address both admitted by the joined private network.
harness.teardown: build/mb-verify/mb-teardown.sh restores the LaunchAgent's original arguments and removes the runtime.

phone.install: debug APK installed over adb on the Z Fold (SM-F966U); install Success
phone.launch: MainActivity starts; workspace screen renders with the expected offline banner ('The Mac did not answer...') because the phone is not yet on the overlay; no crashes in logcat
phone.pending: ZeroTier app present on the phone but no network joined and no VPN active; on-device live verification blocked on the phone-side join plus member authorization in ZeroTier Central

server_checks.admission: GET /api/health 200 with Host set to the Mac's overlay address and X-Lapis-Client: android; loopback probes are refused by design (421 Unknown host on the Host check)
server_checks.listing: GET /api/agents lists both agents running (codex TUI + stand-in)
server_checks.attach_and_stream: SSE stream delivers event: attached (shared true, wheel capability advertised for the alternate-screen program) followed by frame events; 816 frames observed in one 110 s attachment, revisions advancing
server_checks.typing: POST /api/agents/{id}/input with paste+enter reached the real Codex TUI; the fake model completed the turn and the reply rendered in subsequent frames
server_checks.resize: input resize [100,30] and [72,40] re-grid the live TUI; frames report the new columns/rows
server_checks.history_paging: stand-in agent with 3x `count` (360 numbered lines): default history returns page 15, 7 rows, place {total 342, offset 335, rows 7, scrubbable true}; ?at=50 jump returns page 3, 24 rows at offset 48
server_checks.history_gates: alternate-screen Codex TUI correctly reports empty archive end:true ('No more archived history') and refuses ?at= with 'This agent's service cannot jump'; the harvest threshold (min(256, 32768/columns) rows of primary-screen backscroll) explains why short Codex turns archive nothing
server_checks.wheel: input wheel [-3,40,10] delivered to the full-screen program; it reported SGR mouse events ('mouse got 3 events, first ESC[<65;41;11M')
server_checks.artifacts: ignored build/mb-verify/: stream-*.txt, kimi-*.json, history-*.json, codex-wheel*.txt, gateway and helper logs

limitations: Phone-side live typing/resize/scrollback on the cover screen not yet exercised at recording time; since covered on the loopback path by evidence/android-milestone-b-device.json (overlay join still pending)

Concurrent attach from phone plus curl not yet tested; single-attachment verification only. Note: the gateway supersedes a previous SSE stream for the same agent, so a parallel curl observer retires the phone's pump; do not watch a live phone attachment with a second stream.
Mac-side 'stay in sync' observed only via the attach event's shared flag and a single stream client
